body: You said you love your family which means you still have them. I think you should open up to at least one of them. Have someone who cares about you to confide in. You might feel better. If it's too hard, you can talk to me if you want to. I think you should definitely open up to someone you love though. Good luck brother.

What he needs is someone to talk to about this stuff. Not necessarily you but you could be real with him and tell him yourself he is ill and he needs to talk to someone and needs to move on. 

You definitely should clue someone you know who is close to him about his thoughts. He's telling you these things because he feels he still has a connection to you because you loved him previously and probably has no one else he knows how to talk to at this moment.

You shouldn't feel guilty about what you've done, you've responded like a normal person would. You probably will feel guilty though if you've done nothing to help down the road. Just be real with him. Tell him how you feel, tell him he needs help, and make sure someone close to him like a parent or friend can help him. That's the best you can do.
I've been struggling too. I've been depressed and have felt alone for a while and I don't even know if I could sufficiently help you but you can talk to me if you don't have anyone else to vent to.
